During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] '''Admiral Harkov's fleet''' took part in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] intervention of the [[Sepan Civil War]] around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. However, [[Harkov]] defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and later fought the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Harkov was captured and taken prisoner by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] aboard his flagship, the [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']], and after an interrogation, was executed. His fleet continued fighting for the Alliance even after his death, but was mopped up by the Empire.

==Organization==
Then fleet was under the command of Admiral Harkov, and several officers, including [[Vondruln]], who served as his advisor when he defected. His [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] was the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']]. Other vessels of the fleet included the ''[[Akaga]]'', an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]. At least two [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvettes]], [[Wurger]] 1 and 2, were in his fleet. Other vessels in use included the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] and the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]], such as the ''[[Toten]]''.

The [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] contingent under his command [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]], [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], and the new [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s. After his defection to the Alliance, Harkov's squadrons were given the designation "H-" to mark them apart from Imperial squadrons. Squadrons under his command included [[H-Alpha Squadron]], a regular TIE fighter unit, [[H-Delta Squadron]], a TIE interceptor squadron, [[H-Beta Squadron]], [[H-Zeta Squadron]], and [[H-Eta Squadron]] were TIE bomber squadrons, while TIE advanced fighters were flown by [[H-Gamma Squadron]], [[H-Delta Squadron (TIE/ad)|H-Delta Squadron]], and [[H-Beta Squadron (TIE/ad)|H-Beta Squadron]]. Interestingly, the idea of using a letter designation at the beginning of squadron names was later used by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] when he went rogue.

==Behind the scenes==
The fleet made its first and only appearance in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], a 1994 computer game.
